latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: find and book in-network doctors through Zocdoc.com

- Search for providers by specialty, condition, insurance, and location
- Filter results by insurance compatibility and appointment preferences
- View real-time appointment slots and verified patient reviews
- Support for both same-day, virtual, and in-person visits
- Direct users to Zocdoc.com to securely complete booking
